441K likes, 1,249 comments - sakshimalikk on August 28, 2026: "Never had a brother, but honestly, never felt like I needed one. 🤍

I’ve always had my sister, Mum, Dad and my little dogs looking out for me in their own ways.

@aayushimalikk couldn’t be here this Raksha Bandhan, but she always sends me a rakhi. And I tied one on Mum and Dad too because… well, they’ve been protecting me my whole life. 🥹

So I guess I’ve always had my own version of Raksha Bandhan. And my own little team. 🤍".
